title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million on Tuesday after state inspectors found 62 natural gas generators at its Vineland data center site in late July. The tractor trailer size generators, each 2,000 kilowatts, lacked required permits to be installed or operated. The state said the fine was for violating the Air Pollution Control Act and was the largest ever issued to a New Jersey data center operator.

The planned data center is a 2.6 million square foot complex that would need 350 megawatts, enough to power a medium size city, and is slated for completion at the end of the year. Some of it is already in use. Homeowners have filed a federal lawsuit over persistent noise, and the Cumberland County Health Department issued violation orders to DataOne for excessive noise.
